### About Multi Branch

Sat, 16 Aug, 2025

[Articles](https://smart-hospital.in/articles)[Multi Branch](https://smart-hospital.in/category/multi-branch)

---

The Multibranch feature in Smart Hospital enables organizations to manage multiple hospital branches under a single system, allowing centralized control of data, seamless inter-branch operations, and branch-specific configurations for enhanced efficiency and reporting.
